transition_conditions: Bull continuation: a close above 2850, or a second consecutive close above 2771 with the bar closing in its upper third, would confirm acceptance above the range and support trend continuation.

Failed breakout: a close back below 2700, and especially below 2680 (bar 110 high), re-entering the 2357.18-2680 range, would mark bar 120's push as a failed breakout, particularly if the bar closes near its low.
Range continuation: continued overlap with highs capped near 2771-2850 and no new closing high would keep the phase as range and shift the regime read toward trading-range.

Trend damage: a close below 2436.87 (bar 117 low) negates the four-bar leg; a close below 2357.18 (bar 101 low) ends the post-spike higher-low sequence and turns the read to transition-unclear or trading-range.
Deep failure: acceptance below 2111 (bar 88 low) would invalidate the spike structure and return the pre-spike base to relevance.
